name: Night Light
description: A bedtime night light for a child's room. As a screensaver it shows a dim warm light. Press Go to sleep for gentle sleepy music while the screen drifts through soft colours, which then fades back to the warm light.
author: heazlewood

settings.title: Colour show length
settings.description: How long the go to sleep show's colours and music play before they fade back to the warm sleep light.

settings.title: Colours
settings.description: The set of colours the screen drifts through.

settings.title: Colour speed
settings.description: How quickly one colour melts into the next.

settings.title: Colour brightness
settings.description: How bright the colours are. They also dim a little as the show goes on.

settings.title: Fade to sleep light
settings.description: How long the colours and music take to fade back into the sleep light, at the end of the show or after End.

settings.title: Sleep light colour
settings.description: A warm orange or amber is kindest to sleep.

settings.title: Sleep light brightness
settings.description: How bright the warm night light glows.

settings.title: Music
settings.description: What plays during the go to sleep show. The music is made up as it plays, so it never repeats exactly.

settings.title: Volume
settings.description: Music volume, on top of the device's media volume.

settings.title: During the sleep light
settings.description: What plays while the warm night light shows, including when the screensaver first starts.

settings.title: Bedtime countdown
settings.description: Shows a row of stars on the night light, about one per hour of sleep. They go out one by one, so your child can see how long until up time.

settings.title: Bed time
settings.description: When the night starts and every star is lit, such as 19:00 or 7pm.

settings.title: Up time
settings.description: When the last star goes out and it is time to get up, such as 07:00 or 7am. At most 10 stars show.
